## Plugin reference

- Description: Debug → Notifications: every undismissed notification as a DataView (the bell popover's View all), with Open / Dismiss row actions. Its own plugin so the notifications plugin (and its useToast) never imports data-view — data-view raises toasts itself.
- Web:
  - Slots:
    - `notifications.actions`
    - `notification-actions`
  - Slot contributors:
    - `notifications.actions` ← `primitives.pane`
    - `notification-actions` ← `shell.notifications.pane`
  - Contributes:
    - `Pane.Register` "notifications"
    - `DebugApp.Sidebar` "Notifications"
    - `notification-actions` "open" → `OpenNotificationAction`
    - `notification-actions` "dismiss" → `DismissNotificationAction`
  - Uses: 30 symbols — full list in [REFERENCE.md](./REFERENCE.md)
    - `primitives/data-view` ×5
